units.source_text: 千重子店铺里的灶神，七尊都请齐了。

en.t: In Chieko's shop, all seven kitchen gods had been properly enshrined.

units.source_text: 因为只有父母和女儿三口人，在最近十年八年里又都没有死人。

en.t: That was because the household consisted only of her parents and their daughter, and no one had died there in the past seven or eight years.
